modinfo.title: CD Food Cooldown 2s + Full Eat Animation
modinfo.author: Tommy
modinfo.description: Sets all food shared cooldown to 2 seconds (2000ms) for 477 items, and gives Normal difficulty the Hard-mode use action for all 548 consumables (food, herbs, insects, holy water) so the eating animation plays out. Built for Crimson Desert 2.03.02. Food cooldown based on CD Food Cooldown by Rogue69 (Nexus mod 3090). Each change also carries entry + rel_offset so DMM can re-anchor it by record if a future patch moves things.
